caption: The drawing features two renderings of the same mechanical object, which appears to be a handheld device with a circular compass or dial, a viewing lens, and a hinged arm. The upper representation is more detailed and colored, showing metallic surfaces in shades of gray and brown, as well as black markings on the compass face and faint text or numbers. The metallic parts exhibit shading and highlights, suggesting a three-dimensional form. The hinged arm is depicted in an extended position above the main body. Below and slightly to the left, a less finished pencil sketch outlines the same object, showing the basic shape and components with minimal shading, and the markings on the circular component are faintly visible. Both objects are set against a plain, uncolored background, leaving most of the paper empty.
title: Ticket Punch
